newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S COMBINED DOWNHILL OFF.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S COMBINED DOWNHILL OFF.

text.p: High winds forced the postponement of the women's combined downhill at the world ski championships on Thursday.
The race was re-scheduled for Friday morning but Thursday's night slalom second part of the event would go ahead as planned, officials said.
The combined downhill was the first race at the championships to be hit by bad weather. Sestriere has until now enjoyed bright sunshine and perfect conditions.

If the race cannot go ahead on Friday, there is a serious risk that it may be scrapped entirely. Saturday traditional women's downhill takes precedence and the championships end with the floodlit men's slalom the same night.
